content:
Quick answer

A custom soccer uniform is a jersey built around your team's identity — colors, crest, sponsors, names and numbers — made with full dye-sublimation. At MOMUTO there are three routes: the free 3D designer, the Ready to Play catalog, or a custom design ($15 to start, credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys — free for a team order). First draft in 24–48 hours, delivery in 25–30 days, no minimum order. Most club and rec leagues run spring and fall seasons — start the design about five weeks before kickoff.

What is a custom soccer uniform?

It's the opposite of a catalog. Instead of a generic template with a crest slapped on top, it's a jersey designed around your team: your colors, your crest, your sponsors, and a cut fitted to a real roster (from youth XS to adult 4XL). It's made with full dye-sublimation — the ink fuses into the fibers, never sits on top — for unlimited artwork and real durability. See printing & materials.

Getting it right: fabric, printing, sizing

A uniform that holds up through a full season of washes is a polyester/elastane blend (not 100% polyester), printed by full dye-sublimation so the design never cracks or peels. Sizing runs from youth XS to adult 4XL, which lets you dress an entire club in one order. See the size guide.

When to order: the season calendar

Most club and rec leagues run two seasons a year — spring and fall — with a handful of weeks between registration and kickoff. With 25–30 days from order to delivery, plan to lock the design in about five weeks ahead of your season. Running behind, or ordering mid-season for a tournament? A fast lane add-on skips the production queue and saves roughly a week for +$69. See when to order your team uniforms.

The budget: sponsors and fundraising

Most club and rec teams don't pay for uniforms out of pocket — they fund them. Sublimation prints a local sponsor's logo into the fabric (chest, sleeve, back) at no extra cost, and one sponsor often covers a large part of a roster order. Full playbook: fund your team uniforms with sponsors and fundraising.

By format of play

  • Club & rec team — full roster, one identity.
  • Futsal & indoor soccer — lighter jerseys built for the indoor game.
  • Adult rec league — co-ed and pickup teams, no minimum order.
  • Corporate & events — company teams, tournaments, brand activations.
  • Tournaments — one-off uniforms for a weekend or a cup run.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a minimum order for team uniforms?

No. You can order anything from a single jersey to a full roster. The per-jersey price drops with quantity: from $45.90 for one down to $25.90/jersey at 10+.

How far ahead of the season should we order?

Allow 25–30 days between order and delivery. Plan to lock in the design about five weeks before your season starts — earlier if you're ordering around a tournament.

Can we print sponsor logos on the uniform?

Yes. Sublimation prints every logo into the fabric — chest, sleeves and back — with no peeling and no extra cost per logo.

Do you ship nationwide across the US?

Yes. MOMUTO ships to every US address with the same 25–30 day window, no minimum order — from a single jersey to a full roster.
